what: The highlight marker of the section list glides in one beat to the cell of the section currently being read — in a horizontal list it grows or shrinks to fit the cell width, in a vertical table of contents it settles to that row’s height. The current cell gets aria-current, the stacked labels roll one step to become the current section name, and the progress bar fills as much as has been read

options.axis: Pick ”x” and ”y” by checking the default list type
options.line: Screen height (%) at which the section changes, default 50 — 45 for the table of contents
options.look: pill: Pill plate behind the links: before the first segment there is no current slot, so it shrinks to a dot and disappears, and the current link text is --kf-on-accent. Position, width and height move separately (position .6s 0.215,0.61,0.355,1 · width .6s 0.645,0.045,0.355,1 · height .2s).
options.dur: look: pill travel distance (seconds), default .6 — height is 1/3, opacity is 2/3
options.move-ease: look: position and height curve of the pill, default 0.215,0.61,0.355,1

use:
Segment 1… Segment 1…
— the label and progress bar can be omitted
note: Brand’s TOC highlight line (toc-marker) is merged into this part — for a vertical list it uses that row’s height, TOC is at line 45

from.where: index.js initTransport .transport-active·[data-roll=type·topic] (gauge section marker) · page.js initDoc .doc-index (document TOC highlight line · reading progress — line 45)

article.html left table of contents — a gray plate (height 32 · corner 6) settles onto the section line being read. The original is a motion spring (stiffness 800 · damping 80 · mass 2, critically damped, settles in ≈.3s) — axis: y; line: 30; bpm: 133; Matched to ease: 0.16,1,0.3,1
index.html header row .t-header__menu — a pink pill (.l-header__menu .indicator) slides behind the current section link, and in the Hero it shrinks to a dot and disappears — look: pill
shared.js section index (.im-rail__list::before) — the bordered cell moves to the current section row over .52s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), matching width and height
